title: Claude Desktop operator surface
summary: Claude Desktop operator surface — the operator engages DontPanic from within the Anthropic Claude Desktop application.

verify.readiness: Claude Desktop surface is usable when PATH resolves dontpanic, the DontPanic home directory is present, the repo is visible, any declared worktree binding is healthy, the operator config is valid, and MCP is reachable from the desktop app.

dontpanic_core: invocation context resolution for claude_desktop surface
canonical surface id from F001 OperatorSurface enum
operator: installs and runs Claude Desktop application
configures MCP server connection inside Claude Desktop settings

mutation_boundary.allowed_path: Operator surface manifests are read-only descriptors; DontPanic does not mutate Claude Desktop application state or configuration.
forbidden: DontPanic must not write to Claude Desktop application settings directly

notes: Claude Desktop is an external operator surface produced by Anthropic; DontPanic does not bundle or install it.
MCP availability probe checks whether the DontPanic MCP server endpoint is registered and reachable inside Claude Desktop.
